title: Split Part Sale copies the Bill To to the new part sale
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, that bills itself.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new part sale for this test, part sale 1, for customer A, open, billed to customer B, with two parts, part 1 and part 2.
custom_steps:
1. Open part sale 1.
  2. Open Split Part Sale.
  3. Tick part 2.
  4. Confirm the split.
  5. Open the new part sale made by the split.
  6. Expand the Customer card.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part sale 1 opens for customer A.

Step 2:

  • The Split Part Sale window opens.

Step 3:

  • Part 2 is ticked.

Step 4:

  • A new part sale is made with part 2.

Step 5:

  • The new part sale opens with customer A.

Step 6:

  • The Customer card's "Bill To" field reads customer B's name.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card)

  • S3-R7: “Splitting a work order or part sale, or reopening a paid work order onto a new one, copies its Bill To to the new one.”
